data.why: The repo ships no example data and the app only accepts uploaded *_DYN.txt nanoDMA exports, so hand-crafted files matching the Hysitron/Bruker tab-separated header format (with the required 'hardness'+'mod'/'depth' header row) are needed to drive the full workflow, including an outlier indent, missing-value rows, a non-conforming filename, and an unparsable export to exercise the error path.

goals: Load multiple nanoDMA depth-profile exports and verify the sample/fluence/grain/measurement metadata is decoded correctly from file names
Overlay individual indents for one grain to check replicate consistency and spot anomalous indents (e.g. one landing on a grain boundary or crack)
Compute mean/median plus std or SEM depth profiles per grain to compare irradiated vs. unirradiated (control) material
Define a custom group spanning files from different grains or samples and compare its averaged curve against another group
Filter the dataset by sample, fluence or grain to isolate a subset of measurements for closer inspection
Export the exact plotted curves (post-binning) to CSV/ZIP for downstream statistical analysis or figure-making

review.summary: This tree follows the README's workflow closely: upload and decode file names, filter, overlay replicates, aggregate per grain or custom group, then export. Most of the screens I checked support their nodes. Before filing, fix the X-axis node, which was tried in the wrong mode and reported as a bug that isn't one. Also merge the near-duplicate filter tasks and trim the generic chart-click steps.
